gsap_scrolltrigger.description: GSAP ScrollTrigger connects scroll position to animations. Enables scrubbing, pinning, snapping, and scroll-driven camera paths. Free as of 2025.

lenis.description: Lenis is a lightweight smooth scroll library that synchronizes native scroll with requestAnimationFrame, keeping CSS sticky, IntersectionObserver, and GSAP ScrollTrigger all working correctly.

rapier.description: Rapier is a high-performance Rust-based physics engine compiled to WASM. Handles rigid bodies, colliders, joints, gravity, forces, and collision events. Used with Three.js by syncing physics body positions to mesh positions each frame.

howler.description: Howler.js is a full-featured spatial audio library. Supports positional 3D audio (Web Audio API), audio sprites, streaming, fade in/out, and automatic codec detection. Far more capable than Three.js's built-in Audio for immersive experiences.

postprocessing.description: Advanced post-processing library for Three.js by pmndrs. Provides SSR (Screen Space Reflections), SSAO, SSGI, bloom, depth of field, motion blur, and many cinematic effects with excellent performance through effect merging.

lamina.description: Layer-based shader material system for Three.js. Create complex materials by stacking layers (color, depth, fresnel, noise, gradient) without writing GLSL. Perfect for artistic, stylized 3D effects.
lamina.codesnippet:
import { LayerMaterial, Color, Depth, Fresnel, Noise } from 'lamina';

// In R3F component
<mesh>
  <sphereGeometry args={[1, 64, 64]} />
  <LayerMaterial color="#ff0000" lighting="standard">
    <Depth colorA="#00ff00" colorB="#0000ff" alpha={0.5} mode="multiply" near={0} far={2} />
    <Fresnel color="#ffffff" intensity={0.5} power={2} />
    <Noise colorA="#ffffff" colorB="#000000" alpha={0.2} scale={100} type="perlin" />
  </LayerMaterial>
</mesh>

three_custom_shader_material.description: Extend Three.js materials with custom vertex/fragment shaders while keeping lighting, shadows, and fog working. Inject custom GLSL into MeshStandardMaterial, MeshPhysicalMaterial, etc.

maath.description: Math helpers for 3D graphics by pmndrs. Includes easing functions, interpolation, random distributions, geometry utilities, and vector operations optimized for Three.js and R3F.

react_spring_three.description: Spring-physics based animation library for React Three Fiber. Creates fluid, natural-feeling animations for 3D objects with configurable mass, tension, and friction.

theatre_js.description: Professional animation sequencer for Three.js. Timeline-based keyframe animation with visual editor. Perfect for cinematic camera movements, scroll-driven narratives, and complex choreographed animations.

camera_controls.description: Advanced camera control library for Three.js. Smooth transitions, dolly, truck, rotate, zoom with damping. Azimuth/polar angle limits, fit-to-box, and collision detection. Cinema-quality camera behaviors.

three_mesh_bvh.description: BVH (Bounding Volume Hierarchy) acceleration structure for Three.js. 10-100x faster raycasting for complex meshes. Essential for interactive 3D with many objects or detailed geometry.

detect_gpu.description: GPU tier detection for adaptive 3D quality. Classifies devices into tiers (0-3) based on GPU capability. Use to adjust post-processing, shadows, and geometry detail for optimal performance across devices.

three_stdlib.description: Essential Three.js addons as ES6 modules. Includes OrbitControls, EffectComposer, loaders (GLTF, FBX, OBJ), and many other examples from three/examples/jsm as properly typed, tree-shakeable modules.

zustand.description: Lightweight state management for React. Perfect for 3D apps - manage scene state, selected objects, camera modes, UI visibility without prop drilling or heavy context. Works seamlessly with R3F.

leva.description: React-first GUI for debugging and tweaking parameters. Beautiful, modern interface for adjusting colors, numbers, vectors, and custom controls. Essential for 3D development and creative coding.

use_cannon.description: React hooks for cannon-es physics in R3F. Declarative physics bodies, constraints, and collision events. Makes adding realistic physics to 3D scenes simple and performant.

tunnel_rat.description: React portals across renderers. Escape the R3F Canvas to render HTML in the DOM from within 3D components. Perfect for labels, tooltips, and UI overlays that follow 3D objects.

drei_vanilla.description: Drei helpers for vanilla Three.js (without React). Includes pcss soft shadows, cloud, sparkles, and other utilities from @react-three/drei adapted for imperative Three.js code.
